title: Show / List Command Workflow
activity_flow: INIT: new VersionParser(); if --tree then initStyles(output)
FORK: BUILD REPOSITORY SET based on flags:
BRANCH --all (with composer): CompositeRepository([FilterRepository(installedRepo)] + RepositoryManager::getRepositories()); locker check → lockedRepo
BRANCH default/installed: InstalledRepository([RootRepo, localRepo]); if --no-dev filter via RepositoryUtils::filterRequiredPackages()
FORK: SINGLE PACKAGE vs LIST MODE:
=== SINGLE PACKAGE MODE (package arg set with no wildcard) ===
[if package not found → throw InvalidArgumentException with hints]
package.getRequires() → foreach req: addTree(name, link, installedRepo, remoteRepos, visited)
addTree(): getPackage() recursively, build children array, detect circular deps
else: displayPackageTree([arrayTree]) → recursive displayTree() with ASCII ├└│── + color cycling
build JSON struct; appendVersions(); appendLicenses(); appendAutoload(); appendLinks()
printMeta() → name, description, keywords, printVersions(), released, latest, type, printLicenses(), homepage, source, dist, path, names, support, autoload
[if --tree: collect rootRequires, sort packages, forEach root package → generatePackageTree(); displayPackageTree() or JSON]
classify repo → type: platform | locked | available | installed
if ComposerRepository: collect getPackageNames(filter) as strings
else: getPackages() → filter by AliasPackage, packageFilterRegex, packageListFilter (--direct)
FOREACH type in [platform, locked, available, installed]:
[if --latest && showVersion: findLatestPackage() for each object package → latestPackages[]]
compute column widths: nameLength, versionLength, latestLength, releaseDateLength
check terminal width fits: versionFits, latestFits, releaseDateFits, descriptionFits
[if --latest && !--direct: split into directDeps / transitiveDeps, print separately]
printPackages(io, packages, indent, writeVersion, writeLatest, writeDescription, widths):
foreach pkg: pad name, write version, write latest (styled), write release-age, write description (truncated to terminal width, mb_strimwidth), write path, write warning

key_methods.execute: Main entrypoint — validates options, builds repos, dispatches event, routes to single-package or list mode
key_methods.getPackage: Resolves a package by name/version using RepositorySet + pool.whatProvides() + DefaultPolicy
key_methods.generatePackageTree: Builds recursive array tree from package.getRequires() via addTree()
key_methods.addTree: Recursively resolves children, detects circular deps via $packagesInTree visited list
key_methods.displayPackageTree: ASCII tree rendering with ├──└── characters and 5-color cycle
key_methods.displayTree: Recursive display helper, aborts circular deps with warning label
key_methods.getRepositorySet: Lazy-init RepositorySet combining all remote repos (cached in $this->repositorySet)
key_methods.printPackageInfo: Full single-package text output: meta + links
key_methods.printPackages: Column-aligned list output with terminal-width-aware description truncation
key_methods.getRootRequires: Returns merged require+require-dev package names from root package

key_relationships: ShowCommand depends_on RepositorySet + DefaultPolicy (for package resolution)
ShowCommand uses InstalledRepository (wraps multiple repo types)
ShowCommand uses FilterRepository (wrap with canonical/only/exclude filters)
ShowCommand reads CompletePackageInterface (description, keywords, license, autoload, suggests, support)
branching_conditions: --latest / --outdated → fetch latest version per package via VersionSelector
--strict → return exit code 1 if outdated packages found
format=json → JSON output; format=text → aligned table output
single package arg (no wildcard) → single package detail view
package arg with wildcard → regex filter on list mode
important_notes: ShowCommand is the 'composer show'/'composer info' command. Three distinct output paths: (1) single package detail, (2) dependency tree, (3) package list table. Output columns adapt to terminal width using getTerminalWidth(). Abandoned packages trigger warnings. The lazy $repositorySet cache avoids re-creating the full repo pool per package in --latest list mode.
